facts.fact: Government decree 2020-777 of 5 October 2020 sets the conditions and procedures for electronic data exchange between public bodies and their users and between bodies, implementing decree-law 2020-31, and defines a national interoperability operator and interoperability system.
facts.system: Décret gouvernemental n° 2020-777 (échange électronique de données, interopérabilité)

systems.owner: public person in charge of managing the interoperability system
systems.tiers: public and private bodies with a public service mission

note: No fact on use: the passages say public bodies must exchange electronically and meet standards set by joint order, but name no enforcing body.
